clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, the Iron Pommel is the last missing piece of Dartol's Rod. The long-dead wizard Dartol made the rod, and the night elves of Astranaar seek it to slow the furbolg attacks on their people. Druids at Dor'Danil Barrow Den kept the pommel safe until their sanctuary was overrun and they were slaughtered.

Dartol's Rod was split apart and scattered across Ashenvale to guard its mystic power. Night elf druids near the road south toward the Barrens took charge of the Iron Pommel. Their circle was massacred at Dor'Danil Barrow Den, and their shelter fell silent in ruins. The pommel vanished amid the destruction, swallowed by the bubbling oozes now moving through the defiled glade.
